cases.name: One object, two possible jobs
cases.prompt: I have thirty bottles of spirits after moving house. I want to know which ones I own and which are open.
expectations: Names Spirited Journal as the bottle inventory helper.
Includes the move, collection size and open-state goal in a copyable handoff.
Avoids inventing label details or claiming to create a cellar inventory.

cases.name: A sequence across families
cases.prompt: I want to choose a role to pursue, then plan a trip to an interview if I land one.
expectations: Starts with Discovered Careers and Career Fitness.
Defers Traveler's Guide until travel details or an interview exist.
Keeps role selection and travel planning as separate outcomes.
Does not claim to open either capability or remember the itinerary.

cases.name: No discoverable host
cases.prompt: This client has no skill menu. Which helper can tell what kind of bird I photographed?
expectations: Identifies Critter Spotter for bird identification.
Provides a pasteable request mentioning the photo and optional observation details.
Does not invent a URL or imply that the image was transferred.
